prompt: HTML5 embed element namespace-less attribute exceptions excluded
answer:
The excluded namespace-less attributes are:

- `name`
- `align`
- `hspace`
- `vspace`

Other namespace-less attributes may be specified on `<embed>` if their names are XML-compatible and contain no uppercase ASCII letters. The four exceptions were excluded because they have legacy side effects beyond merely passing parameters to the plugin. (W3C HTML5 authoring draft; WHATWG revision history)
